native_source_references.finding: Select can dispose of Mini when base.unk58 bit 0x400 is clear. It creates the native ability star and restores Normal dimensions/state.
Common call/return eligibility excludes specified active session rooms. Room 134 is not in that table.
R initiation distinguishes whether all Kirbys already share the room.
Common R checks Mini before caller, battery, human-player and room-priority conditions. Phone ownership cannot bypass this native Mini restriction.
The observed idle state calls the common R macro and separately checks L. The L branch requires session eligibility, global flag 4 clear, room priority 0x40 and ability other than Mini.
The native R and L paths are separate. Normal R consumes one battery and starts helper calling; Normal L uses the return path.
Room-entry processing independently clears Mini. In this witness Mini was already disposed of by Select before any return, so this is source corroboration, not a separately tested Mini transition.
The ordinary L return reaches native room 801 and the subsequent control states.
The property record has 40-byte stride and priorityFlags at offset 18; the unchanged room 134 value is 0x79.
The session-room table starts at 0x0835105C and excludes 134.
The native room-property table starts at 0x089331AC.
AI progression 300 is the native normal progression state, not human-player count.
The first Central Circle cutscene advances AI progression to 300 and saves WORLD state.
MINNY is excluded from randomized source assignments. Original Minny remains the genuine Mini source.
The current production client derives gate and unlock masks from slot configuration and received ability items. The Mini item unlocks bit 23; it does not equip Mini.
Phone guards only R entry 0x08056C2C. L entry 0x08056E40 is separate; common Mini rejection occurs before R entry.
Production enable remains 0. Only the isolated fixture changes the enable word to 1 before boot.
The permission gate does not replace native call eligibility. Room 134 is outside the 803-805 tutorial exception.
Phone ownership uses the production queue with complete history, ROM identity, capability and native-file fences.

limits: This is a controlled local room 134 entry matching the native 133-to-134 arrival, not a complete Central Circle-to-source journey or campaign. Encoded 40,120 gives initial 24,104; native ground settling yields 24,104.99609375 at the first recorded gameplay frame 1085.

The current production source policy uses mode 2 / per_grant_event, all 25 allowed abilities, no-ability weight 100, fixed Minny and fixed statues, ability gating ON, Area Keys OFF, enemy health 100%, HP 6/6. Only this policy and health configuration are tested.

Mini is acquired at 1429 from the original room 134 Minny after real controller inhalation and swallowing. Synthetic item 3860123 supplies only Mini permission; it does not equip Mini. Included randomized sources always resolve to Normal under the selected 100% weight.

Original startup CPU entries remain 803 with original positions. CPUs naturally reach 801 by 1271; no helper room, equipment or AI progression is injected. All source/room 134 work has AI progression 0. First return to 801 triggers the ordinary cutscene and advances to 300.

Restricted R and L are tested in common idle state 0x0803FF65 at x 656.74609375, y 248.99609375 with base.unk58=0x201, so Select disposal is eligible. This is not an all-state, underwater, cramped-space, multiplayer or arbitrary-room guarantee.

After Select, Normal movement and R/L behavior are restored. Unowned enabled R remains permission-blocked, owned and disabled R summon all helpers with one battery spent, and L returns in all cases. No helper attack, switch, collectible, route necessity or Phone-required obstacle is claimed.

Eight current production source-configuration writes occur at 1085. Those source writes are not individually guarded. Owned cases add two guarded Phone queue writes at 2551. There are no equipment, pose, HP, battery, direct ownership, helper or other gameplay-state writes, and no state loads.

The harness uses real libmGBA 0.10.5 and production client routines with a local transport adapter and complete synthetic ReceivedItems. No live AP server, full client watcher or BizHawk Lua transport is claimed.

Production Phone remains disabled and absent from generated slot capability. Only experimental client contexts add protocol 1 and starting ownership False. The disabled control retains the untouched production enable 0 and no experimental slot additions.

The common Mini/Select/R/L source range is byte-identical to retail except the already-existing four-byte button-transition hook at 0x0803FFD4. Native L/return and room-entry reset ranges are byte-identical to retail. The whole common handler is not claimed to be pristine retail.

The initial startup assertion stopped before configuration because y 104 was too strict; native ground settling is 104.99609375. A successful pilot is excluded. Only the four final accepted cold runs enter this packet.
ROMs, saves, screenshots, full traces, complete transport reads and generated archives remain private. This document contains only sanitized metadata and telemetry.
